core_rule: Generic HTTP must not become an uncontrolled escape hatch around DLP.
approved_use_cases: webhook patterns with explicit endpoint allowlist and logging
prohibited_use_cases: generic HTTP mixed with Dataverse without review
authentication_requirements: Microsoft Entra ID or approved secret handling
endpoint_restrictions: Use DLP endpoint filtering where available; otherwise document connector-specific allowlist.
exception_process: Founder & CEO may approve, but exception record must include endpoint, data class, owner, logging, rollback, and review date.
bp09_preservation: Website /api/intake Dataverse service-principal path remains governed and unchanged.
